description: This file contains several exported functions for interacting with a notes database via Supabase API. It includes functions to insert, fetch, update like/bookmark counts, fetch user-specific notes, and delete notes, acting as a data access layer or API interface for a note-taking application.

methods.name: insertNote({ title, description, subject = null, tags = [], file_path, file_url, user_id })
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the 'notes' table with provided details.

methods.name: fetchNotes({ q = '', tag = '', sort = 'created_at_desc', limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: fetchNoteById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: toggleLike(noteId, userId)
methods.description: Toggles the like status for a note by a user and updates the like count.

methods.name: toggleBookmark(noteId, userId)
methods.description: Toggles the bookmark status for a note by a user and updates the bookmark count.

methods.name: fetchUserNotes(userId)
methods.description: Returns all notes created by a specified user.

methods.name: deleteNote(noteId, userId)
methods.description: Deletes a note if the user is authorized (matches user_id).

ctags.pattern: /^export async function insertNote({ title, description, subject = null, tags = [], file_path, fil/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, subject = null, tags = [], file_path, file_url, user_id })
